tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT
TIME AND DATE OF SUBMISSION OF SAMPLE AND DEMONSTRATION OF MODEL EQUIPMENT AS PER ANNEXURE 4 16/09/2026 between 11:00am to 3.00pm (for participating bidders only)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should be the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or An authorized OEM certified dealer

OEM presence in India Proof of at least 3 years of presence in India with commercial activities in technology solutions.OEM must have their own manufacturing/contract manufacturing facility in India from last 3 years for manufacturing Interactive Display Board. Same factory address must appear on BIS certificate for quoted product.
Certificate of Registration The bidder shall be a Company registered with concerned authority and should be operating in India for the past Three years. (2023-2024, 2024-25, and 2025-26)
ISO, IEC & BIS Certificates of the Bidders/ Manufacturer

The Bidder shall have Service Centres in each of the districts being serviced (for the purpose of service centres, bidders own service centres in case of authorized dealer or OEMs service centres of similar products or MOU with any existing service centres in the districts are considered.) to provide requisite services to destinations as per Annexure-3
The bidder shall submit valid documentary proof of GST registration number, PAN and the details of income tax registration.

The bidder shall have executed Supply of IT Hardware and Maintenance of similar projects worth not less than Rs. 7200 lakhs for in any one of the last 3 Years to any Government / PSUs.The bidder shall have executed supply of Interactive Display Board/Similar products of Rs. 2700 lakhs in single contract/order/bill. For MSME as per order FD908 Exp-12/2019 dated 21-07-2020 is applicable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices (Black List) issued by any State Government or PSU or by Government of India or Local Bodies as on Bid Submission Date.
Land Border Preferences As per Government Order NO:FD455 Exp-12/2020 Bengaluru, Dated:01/04/2023
The bidder shall have positive net worth in each of the last 3 audited financial years (2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-25).
